road.name: Sol Duc Road (start) / Whiskey Bend Road, Elwha (exit)
road.status: Paved, generally open year-round to Sol Duc Falls trailhead area; upper sections can close temporarily for winter storm damage or repair work
road.driveNote: Sol Duc Road is paved and open to vehicles to the Sol Duc Trailhead, the standard start. The Elwha-side Whiskey Bend Road is currently closed to vehicles (open to foot/bike travel only) due to flood damage, adding several miles if exiting that way -- verify current status before driving.

access.fees: No trailhead fee. Lake Constance is a quota area in Olympic National Park: the overnight wilderness permit costs $8 per person per night for ages 16 and over, plus a $6 non-refundable reservation fee for each permit. An Olympic National Park Annual Wilderness Pass is $45 per person.
access.permit: NPS wilderness permit for overnight camping at Lake Constance; early reservation recommended May 1-Sept 30
access.closures: Dosewallips Road (FS 2610) closed to vehicles since 2002
access.landManager: Olympic National Park (upper mountain/Lake Constance); Olympic National Forest / Buckhorn Wilderness (approach corridor)

overnight_permit.what: Olympic NP wilderness camping permit; Lake Constance is a quota area
overnight_permit.where: Reserve on Recreation.gov well ahead for May through September. Bear canisters are required at the lake.
